{"bullets": [{"text": "The founder-written essay explaining why readers should care about search privacy is replaced by a corporate privacy policy for Duck Duck Go, Inc. Coverage now extends past search to apps and extensions used while browsing, reading email, using chatbots, and using other apps.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "The rest of this page tries to explain why you should care."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "I (Gabriel Weinberg) am the founder of Duck Duck Go and personally wrote this privacy policy."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "DuckDuckGo (officially, Duck Duck Go, Inc.) has been an independent company since our founding in 2008."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "While we started as a search engine, our apps and extensions now offer protection well beyond search, including when browsing the web, reading email, using chatbots, and even using other apps."}]}, {"text": "The old absolute promise not to collect or share personal information, and not to log User agent and IP data at all, is gone. The new policy says device information is used only temporarily to deliver content and for security, that some product data may be used anonymously against fraud and abuse, and that search, chat, and browsing history are not saved or shared. It also says IP addresses and unique identifiers that could be tied back to you are never logged to disk.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "DuckDuckGo does not collect or share personal information."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "we do not log (store) it at all."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "we only use this information temporarily to deliver content to you and, for security, to ensure"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "Similarly, we may also anonymously use information we receive from you when using our products and features, such as click timing in Email Protection, for security, and to protect against fraud and abuse."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "save or share your search, chat, or browsing history when you search on DuckDuckGo, chat on Duck.ai, or use our apps and extensions."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "we never log IP addresses to disk that could be tied back to you."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "never log unique identifiers to disk that could be tied back to you or to your search, chat, or browsing history."}]}, {"text": "Search results are still described as anonymous, and anonymous queries may still be saved to improve search. New details say local results use a random nearby location that is never logged to disk, content is fetched on the user\u2019s behalf so hosting and content providers cannot build a history of searches, chats, and browsing, and ISPs and network providers still see the IP for routing but not the queries on the encrypted connection.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "We use aggregate, non-personal search data to improve things like misspellings."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "viewing search results on DuckDuckGo is anonymous."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "to improve our search indexes by analyzing anonymous search trends, so that we can better serve you."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "sends us a random location nearish to you, which we also never log to disk."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "we also prevent our hosting and content providers from creating a history of your searches, chats, and browsing."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "these providers necessarily use IP addresses to route information."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "the encrypted connection between you and us prevents your queries from being revealed to any of these entities."}]}, {"text": "Optional features may now require limited personal information used only for that feature. Email Protection requires an email address, and Duck.ai, Sync & Backup, and the DuckDuckGo Subscription are treated the same way. If chats are stored encrypted on servers with Sync & Backup, the policy says DuckDuckGo cannot decrypt and read them.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "We offer optional privacy-protecting features that require limited personal information to function."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "For optional features, we only request personal information necessary for the feature to function and only use the information for that purpose."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "Email Protection is an optional feature that requires your email address to function"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "We take the same approach with other optional features like Duck.ai, Sync & Backup, and our DuckDuckGo Subscription"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "storing chats in encrypted form on our servers with Sync & Backup"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "DuckDuckGo cannot decrypt and read your chats in any case."}]}, {"text": "The default \u201cno cookies\u201d statement is replaced. Settings may be stored in anonymous cookies or URL parameters, display choices may use local storage, experiments may use browser storage without identifying the user or their history, and signed-in optional features such as Email Protection use only the storage needed for that feature.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "At DuckDuckGo, no cookies are used by default."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "if you prefer not to use cookies to store settings, you can use URL parameters instead."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "We offer a variety of settings that use anonymous cookies for storage, and also offer the option to configure search settings via anonymous URL parameters if you prefer."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "we use local storage on your device for anonymous display settings."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "we never store any information that could identify you or your searches, chats, or browsing history."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "if you use optional features, such as staying signed in to our Email Protection, we use only the minimal necessary storage to allow that feature to perform."}]}, {"text": "The affiliate-code explanation for commissions from sites such as Amazon and eBay is removed. The new policy says most money comes from private search ads based on the results page rather than on the person, and that Microsoft, which manages ad clicks, has committed not to tie ad-click behavior to a user profile or to store or share it except for accounting.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "we may add an affiliate code to some eCommerce sites (e.g. Amazon & eBay) that results in small commissions being paid back to DuckDuckGo when you make purchases at those sites."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "We make most of our money from private search ads on our search engine."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "search ads on DuckDuckGo are based on the search results page"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "and not based on you as a person."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "Microsoft has committed to not associate your ad-click behavior with a user profile and to not store or share that information other than for accounting purposes."}]}, {"text": "The policy no longer explains default search-leakage redirects, HTTPS Everywhere-style link rewriting, POST requests, a Tor exit enclave, or !proxy. It now says other sites\u2019 policies apply when you open them directly, click external links, or use !bang shortcuts, that app and extension Smarter Encryption helps use more encrypted connections, and that a site such as Facebook still knows what you do there.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "DuckDuckGo prevents search leakage by default."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "It is modeled after (and uses code from) the HTTPS Everywhere FireFox add-on."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "You can turn on POST requests on our settings page"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "DuckDuckGo actually operates a Tor exit enclave, which means you can get end to end anonymous and encrypted searching using Tor & DDG together."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "You can enter !proxy domain into DuckDuckGo as well"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "Keep in mind that when you visit other websites by navigating to them directly, by clicking external links on our search engine, or by using our !bang shortcuts, the privacy policies and practices of those other websites apply, including any information you submit to them."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "our Smarter Encryption also helps you use more encrypted connections when visiting other websites."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "if you browse Facebook, Facebook will know what you do on their site."}]}, {"text": "Legal-request language changes from complying with court orders while expecting nothing useful to give, to saying linked search, chat, or browsing histories cannot be provided, disclosing only limited information such as a newsletter email if legally forced, fighting that disclosure, and emailing the user unless forbidden. The new text also allows cross-border transfers of that limited information and points to a Privacy Rights page for deletion or copy requests.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "Also, like anyone else, we will comply with court ordered legal requests."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "there is nothing useful to give them"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "provide search, chat, or browsing histories linked to you in response to legal requests"}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "we will only disclose the very limited personal information that we might have, for example, your email address if you subscribe to our newsletter, if we are legally forced to do so, and we will use legal means to fight against such disclosure."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "If required by law to disclose any of your personal information and we have your email address, we will notify you by email unless legally forbidden to do so."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "we may transfer this limited personal information (for example, your email address) to countries other than the country in which it was received."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "For information about these rights, such as requesting deletion or a copy of your personal information, please review our Privacy Rights page."}]}, {"text": "Notice of policy changes no longer promises a red Updated label for at least 30 days next to the footer link on the about page. Changes are posted on the website with the last-modified date and an update message at the top. The new policy also says personal information has never been sold and that DuckDuckGo does not knowingly market to or solicit information from children under 13.", "citations": [{"hunk": "h1", "side": "removed", "quote": "If this policy is substantively updated, we will update the text of this page and provide notice to you at https://duckduckgo.com/about by writing '(Updated)' in red next to the link to this page (in the footer) for a period of at least 30 days."}, {"hunk": "h1", "side": "added", "quote": "We will notify you of changes by posting the modified version on our website.
